daily.chronicle: The bell rang at eleven and the square was quiet. No Classroom scrolls, no M&T alerts, no footage from Angie's, and Neon Hollow still has no networks linked. Cap'n Twirl's harbor shows no orders and the same thin shelves. Nothing stirred, so the spokes rested and the clock kept good time.

The bell rang at eleven and the square was quiet. Lantern Peak saw no Classroom scrolls and Copperhold no bank notices. Neon Hollow's stalls are still unplugged from Metricool, with Angie's Raw folder empty. At Spindrift Harbor I checked the pulse myself: no orders, nothing waiting to ship. The quest board had no new posts. I kept the clock wound.
